title: State of Gujarat v. Ambica Mills Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: State of Gujarat v. Ambica Mills Ltd., (1974) 4 SCC 656
content.holding: A post-Constitution law violating Article 19 is not void ab initio as against non-citizens or corporations who do not possess Article 19 rights; established relative voidness.
content.relevance: Relative voidness and applicability of laws to non-citizens.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (1974) 4 SCC 656; 1974 INSC 73; 1974 (3) SCR 760; post-constitutional law void against non-citizens and doctrine of eclipse.
